mainEntity.name: How can AI Overviews optimization help an optometry practice in a competitive market like New York City?

acceptedAnswer.text: In a highly competitive market like New York City, AI Overviews optimization offers a distinct advantage. By directly providing answers to common eye care questions, your practice can bypass some traditional organic search competition and appear prominently at the top of search results. This increases your visibility to potential patients actively seeking information or services, differentiating your practice from numerous others and helping to establish you as a leading authority in local eye care.
acceptedAnswer.description: In competitive markets like New York City, AI Overviews optimization helps practices stand out by appearing prominently at the top of search results, increasing visibility and authority.
